mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned Springpole Gold Project, northwestern Ontario. Updated PFS Nov 18, 2025 (technical report filed Dec 23, 2025, eff. Dec 1, 2025, prepared by Ausenco): 30,000 tpd open-pit operation; 9.4-yr LOM; avg payable production 330 koz Au/yr (years 1-5), 281 koz/yr LOM; total net cash costs US$742/oz (years 1-5), US$802/oz LOM; AISC US$877/oz (years 1-5), US$938/oz LOM. Base case (US$3,100/oz Au, US$35.50/oz Ag, 0.74 C$/US$): pre-tax NPV5% US$3.2B, after-tax NPV5% US$2.1B; pre-tax IRR 54%, after-tax IRR 41%; after-tax payback 1.8 yrs. Spot case (US$4,200/oz Au): pre-tax NPV5% US$5.6B / after-tax US$3.8B; IRR 54%/82% pre-tax, 41%/63% after-tax. Initial capex US$1,104M; sustaining US$323M; closure US$40M. Environmental assessment (federal + provincial) and Indigenous consultation in progress. No production yet. Silver resource figure updated in 2025 PFS resources (see below).
Gold project, Quebec. Exploration-stage; no production.

notes: Developer; no FY2025 production or revenue. TSX:FF, OTCQX:FFMGF, Frankfurt:FMG. CEO Dan Wilton. Flagship: Springpole (one of Canada's largest undeveloped gold-silver projects). Note: earlier (2021) PFS declared P&P reserves of 3.8 Moz Au + 20.5 Moz Ag (121.6 Mt @ 0.97 g/t Au, 5.23 g/t Ag); the Nov 2025 updated PFS reports resources (indicated 191 Mt @ 0.78 g/t Au = 4.8 Moz; inferred 64 Mt @ 0.38 g/t Au = 0.8 Moz) with reserve update pending final engineering. All economics in USD.
